title: Running Commentary on Torah 19 — Tefilah l'Chavakuk
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 19 — תפילה לחבקוק
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening pasuk**: **"Tefilah l'Chavakuk ha'navi al shigyonos"** (Chavakuk 3:1). Decoded at end (Rashi + Targum): **shigyonos = shogeg**; Targum **"tirgumah d'odiyasa"** — essential shleimus of lashon ha'kodesh is via lashon Targum.

intermediate.en: **"Tefilah l'Chavakuk... al shigyonos"** (Chav 3:1). Decoded: **shigyonos=shogeg**; Targum "tirgumah" → shleimus lashon ha'kodesh via Targum.
intermediate.he: **"תפילה לחבקוק... על שגיונות"** (חב' ג, א). פענוח: **שגיונות=שוגג**; תרגום "תרגומא" → שלמות לשוה"ק דרך תרגום.

beginner.en: **Frame**: from **Sifra d'Tzni'usa Perek Kadma'ah** (Zohar Terumah 176b): **'ad lo havi masakla, lo havi mashgichin apin b'apin'** — 'before there was the matkala (scale/balance), there was no gazing face-to-face.' The whole Torah will decode this line: **matkala = shleimus lashon ha'kodesh**; **apin b'apin = panim b'panim = pnei ha'tzaddik becoming a mirror in which one sees his own state and repents without rebuke**.

intermediate.en: **Sifra d'Tzni'usa I (Zohar Terumah 176b)**: **"ad lo havi matkala, lo havi mashgichin apin b'apin."** Decoded: **matkala=shleimus LhK; apin b'apin=panim b'panim** (tzaddik's face=mirror).
intermediate.he: **ספרא דצניעותא פ"א (זוה"ק תרומה קעו:)**: **"עד לא הוה מתקלא, לא הוה משגיחין אפין באפין".** פענוח: **מתקלא=שלמות לשוה"ק; אפין באפין=פנים בפנים** (פני הצדיק=מראה).

intermediate.en: **"א"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"א"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"People ask: why travel to the tzaddik to hear from his mouth — one can read sifrei mussar? Great difference: **one who hears from the mouth of the tzaddik ha'emes himself** vs one who hears from a transmitter vs one who hears from a hearer-of-hearer — each rung **drops a level from the tzaddik's mouth**. And between hearing from the tzaddik and reading in a book — even greater chiluk."**

intermediate.en: **א. Why travel to tzaddik?** Huge difference between hearing **directly** vs via transmitter vs via reader of a book — each rung more distant.
intermediate.he: **א. מדוע לנסוע לצדיק?** הבדל גדול בין שמיעה **ישירה** לבין מפי מוסר לבין עיון בספר — כל דרגה רחוקה יותר.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. שמיעה ישירה מול מפי מוסר/ספר.

intermediate.en: **"ב"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ב"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"One must **purify the face** so each person can see his own face in his face **like in a mirror** — until **without rebuke or mussar, his fellow immediately regrets his deeds** just from gazing at his face — for by gazing he sees himself as in a mirror, how his face is sunk in darkness."**

intermediate.en: **Purify the face** so fellow sees own state mirrored → regret without rebuke.
intermediate.he: **זיכוך הפנים** כדי שהזולת רואה מצבו במראה → חרטה בלי תוכחה.

intermediate.en: **"ג"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ג"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"The greatness of **lashon ha'kodesh** — with which the world was created. Chazal (Bereshis Rabbah 18:4; Rashi Bereshis 2:23): **'la'zos yikarei ishah ki mei'ish lukachah zos'** (Bereshis 2:23) — 'lashon nofeil al lashon, mi'kan she'nivra ha'olam bi'lashon ha'kodesh.'"** **"**Chavah** = bechina of **'lailah l'lailah yechaveh da'as'** (Tehillim 19:3) = the **dibbur of lashon ha'kodesh** with which the world was created. **'La'zos yikarei ishah'** = the dibbur — **'v'zos asher diber lahem'** (Bereshis 49:28)."** **"Via lashon ha'kodesh we are **elevated above all the lashonos** — **'lashon nofeil al lashon'** — the ra of the nations' tongues is nullified and falls before LhK; no rule over Israel."** **"The **ra ha'kolel** — containing all 70 lashonos' evils = the **burning of ta'avas ni'uf** (all 70 sunk in it) — falls before LhK. Zohar Vayakhel 203a: **'medorah shel shivin kochvin'** = ra kolel = burning of ta'avas ni'uf = 70 umos within."** **"**Chashmal = chayos esh memal'los** (Chagigah 13a). **Chayos + esh = Chavah + ishah** = LhK — through which the **esh ha'medorah shel shivin kochvin** is **m'melat** (shattered/articulated away). **Mal** of chashmal = shivin kochvin shattered by LhK. LhK = kodesh — 'kol makom she'atah motzei geder ervah, atah motzei kedushah' (Midrash Rabbah Kedoshim 24)."** **"Rashi (Bereshis 2:24): **'al kein ya'azov ish es aviv v'es imo v'davak b'ishto'** — 'from here arayos were forbidden to Noach's sons — **ru'ach ha'kodesh amrah kein'** (Bereshis Rabbah 18; Rashi). Ru'ach ha'kodesh = LhK (Zohar Acharei 61b) — 'u'vru'ach piv kol tz'va'am' (Tehillim 33:6) — via LhK ta'avas ni'uf is bound. **Ru'ach shtus** (Sotah 3a) nullified by **ru'ach ha'kodesh**."** **"**Tikkun ha'bris = ru'ach ha'kodesh** — 'v'lo kamah od ru'ach b'ish' (Yehoshua 2:11; Zevachim 116a). **'Va'yisgor basar tachteinah — lo nitzrechah ela li'mkom ha'chatach'** (Berachos 61a) = **chituch ha'dibbur**. **'Va'yiven'** — 'asa'ah k'otzar': essential building/tikkun of LhK = 'yiras Hashem hi otzaro' (Yeshayahu 33:6) — **'sof davar ha'kol nishma, es ha'Elokim yera'** (Kohelet 12:13). **'K'otzar shel chitim'** — chitah = **22 osiyos** of LhK (Tikkun 16). 'Elokim diber b'kadsho' (Tehillim 60:8) = dibbur ha'kodesh depends on 'Elokim yera.'"** **"Yosef had shleimus LhK — **'ki pi ha'medaber aleichem'** (Bereshis 45:12) = LhK; hence of him: **'ha'nimtza kazeh ish asher ru'ach Elokim bo'** (Bereshis 41:38) — ru'ach Elokim = tikkun ha'bris = "lo kamah od ru'ach b'ish." **Tikkun ha'bris + shleimus LhK — mutually dependent**."** **"**'V'ro'eh zonos ye'abed hon'** (Mishlei 29:3) — **'al tikrei mei'honcha ela mi'g'roncha'** (on Mishlei 3:9; Pesikta; Be'er Heitev OC 53). Blemish in bris destroys LhK. **'Kabed es Hashem mei'honcha'** (Mishlei 3:9) — kabed dayka — kavod depends on bris. Shame is in makom eryan (Tikkunim 58 on 'v'lo yisboshashu' — Bereshis 2:25 — 'no shame except in ervah'). Eryan = pgam ha'bris = **cherpah** (Bereshis 34:14 'ki cherpah hi lanu'). Kabed mei'honcha/mei'g'roncha = shleimus LhK."** **"**Yosef = 'asaf Elokim es cherpasi'** (Bereshis 30:23) = shleimus LhK = tikkun ha'bris."** **"**Nachash = ra ha'kolel**. When LhK has no shleimus, nachash rules LhK (Zohar: 'nachash shultonei al bisra') = **chavah = 'basar mi'besarv'** (Bereshis 2:23; 'b'sar kodesh,' Chagai 2:12). Nachash seduced Chavah, cast zohamah (Shabbos 146a) = **ru'ach se'arah** (Yechezkel 1) = ru'ach shtus = **eishes k'silus** (Mishlei 9:13) — seducing **ru'ach ha'kodesh = LhK = ishah chachamah** (Shmuel II 14:2) = **'chachmos nashim'** (Mishlei 14:1). **'La'pesach chatas roveitz'** (Bereshis 4:7) = **'pischei picha'** (Michah 7:5) of LhK — chatas crouches there to suckle."**

intermediate.en: **LhK = ishah/Chavah** ("zos asher diber," Ber 49:28; "lailah l'lailah yechaveh," Teh 19:3; "lashon nofeil al lashon," BR 18:4 Rashi). LhK fells all 70 lashonos. **Ra kolel = ta'avas ni'uf = medorah shel shivin kochvin** (Zohar Vayakhel 203a). **Chashmal** = chayos esh memal'los (Chag 13a) → shivin kochvin shattered (מ״ל of chashmal). LhK=kedushah (MR Kedoshim 24 "geder ervah=kedushah"). **Tikkun ha'bris + LhK** mutually dependent ("lo kamah od ru'ach," Yeh 2:11; "mi'kan nasar arayos," Rashi Ber 2:24; "ru'ach ha'kodesh," Zohar Acharei 61b). Yosef "pi ha'medaber" (Ber 45:12) → "ru'ach Elokim" (Ber 41:38); "asaf Elokim es cherpasi" (Ber 30:23). Shleimus LhK="otzar yiras Hashem" (Yesh 33:6; Koh 12:13); 22 osiyos=chitah (Tikkun 16). Pgam: "v'ro'eh zonos ye'abed hon/g'ron" (Mishlei 29:3; 3:9). **Nachash** on **basar/chavah** (Zohar; Ber 2:23; Chag 2:12); seduces **ishah chachamah (LhK)** via **eishes k'silus/ru'ach se'arah** (Mishlei 9:13; Yech 1); "la'pesach chatas roveitz" (Ber 4:7; Michah 7:5).
intermediate.he: **לשוה"ק = אשה/חוה** ("זאת אשר דיבר", בר' מט, כח; "לילה ללילה יחווה", תה' יט, ג; "לשון נופל על לשון", ב"ר יח, ד רש"י). לשוה"ק מפיל כל ע' לשונות. **רע הכולל = תאוות ניאוף = מדורה של שבעין כוכבין** (זוה"ק ויקהל רג.). **חשמ"ל** = חיות אש ממללות (חג' יג.) → שבעין כוכבין מתרסקים (מ"ל דחשמל). לשוה"ק=קדושה (מד"ר קדושים כד "גדר ערווה=קדושה"). **תיקון ברית + לשוה"ק** תלויים זה בזה ("ולא קמה עוד רוח", יהו' ב, יא; "מכאן נאסר עריות", רש"י בר' ב, כד; "רוח הקודש", זוה"ק אחרי סא:). יוסף "פי המדבר" (בר' מה, יב) → "רוח אלוקים" (בר' מא, לח); "אסף אלוקים את חרפתי" (בר' ל, כג). שלמות לשוה"ק="אוצר יראת ה'" (יש' לג, ו; קה' יב, יג); כ"ב אותיות=חיטה (תיקון טז). פגם: "ורועה זונות יאבד הון/גרון" (מש' כט, ג; ג, ט). **נחש** על **בשר/חוה** (זוה"ק; בר' ב, כג; חגי ב, יב); מפתה **אשה חכמה (לשוה"ק)** דרך **אשת כסילות/רוח סערה** (מש' ט, יג; יחז' א); "לפתח חטאת רובץ" (בר' ד, ז; מיכה ז, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. לשוה"ק = חוה/אשה (בר' ב, כג; מט, כח; תה' יט, ג; ב"ר יח, ד). לשון נופל על לשון; מדורה של שבעים כוכבים (זוה"ק ויקהל רג.); חשמל=חיות אש ממללות (חג' יג.). גדר ערוה=קדושה (מד"ר קדושים כד; רש"י בר' ב, כד; זוה"ק אחרי סא:). יוסף (בר' מא, לח; מה, יב; ל, כג). יראה=אוצר (יש' לג, ו; קה' יב, יג; תיקון טז). מש' כט, ג; ג, ט. נחש/ניאוף (זוה"ק; שבת קמו.; מיכה ז, ה; בר' ד, ז).

intermediate.en: **"ד"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ד"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"**Eishes k'silus** (= all 70 lashonos' ra) cannot suckle from **ishah chachamah (LhK)** except via bechina of **Etz ha'Da'as tov va'ra** — through it she seduces LhK and casts zohamah. **Etz ha'Da'as** (containing tov+ra) is an **intermediary** between LhK (all tov) and 70-umos tongue (all ra)."**

intermediate.en: **ד. Eishes k'silus (70 lashonos)** suckles from **LhK** only via **Etz ha'Da'as tov va'ra**=intermediary.
intermediate.he: **ד. אשת כסילות (ע' לשונות)** יונקת מ**לשוה"ק** רק דרך **עץ הדעת טוב ורע**=אמצעי.

beginner.en: **"**Etz ha'da'as tov va'ra = lashon Targum** — intermediary between LhK and 70-umos-lashon. To suckle, they must pass through Targum. Targum = **'ishah maskeles'** (Mishlei 19:14) = **'maskil al yedei turgeman'** (Pesachim 117a) — has both tov and ra: sometimes **maskil**, sometimes **m'shachel** (destructive). Eishes k'silus seduces ishah chachamah **via ishah maskeles** = Targum; ikar klipah-hisgabrus via Targum — 'Arami oveid avi' (Devarim 26:5), 'min Aram yancheini Balak' (Bamidbar 23:7) — Targum = Aramaic."** **"Essential **binyan + shleimus of LhK** = by **felling the ra of Targum** and **raising the tov of Targum into LhK** — this completes LhK."** **"**Lavan ha'Arami = 'Arami oveid avi'** — wanted to suckle via Targum, called **'yegar sahadusa'** (Bereshis 31:47). **Yaakov** raised Targum into LhK — called it **'Gal Ed'** in LhK."** **"**'Va'yapel Hashem Elokim tardeimah'** (Bereshis 2:21) — **'tardeimah' = gematria Targum** (per L'kutei Torah of Arizal, parshas Va'eschanan) — essential binyan of LhK via Targum."** **"Raising tov of Targum + felling ra → all 70 lashonos fall = 'lashon nofeil al lashon.' **'Va'yapel'** = r"t: **V**eh L**o** Y**edabrei/P**eh L**ahem V**'lo Y**edabrei** (Tehillim 115:5; 135:16 — notarikon: P.L.V.Y. = VA'YAPEL)."** **"**Yosef** with shleimus LhK could **pashar chalmin** (Bereshis 41) — because dreams are in **sheinah = tardeimah** (the sleep-state bound to Targum). Yosef merited shleimus LhK via mastering Targum/tardeimah — knowing how to separate tov+ra in the chalom, lift tov into LhK."**

intermediate.en: **Targum=Etz ha'Da'as=intermediary; aka ishah maskeles/maskil-m'shachel** (Mishlei 19:14; Pes 117a "maskil al yedei turgeman"). Klipah-hisgabrus via Targum=Aramaic ("Arami oveid avi," Dev 26:5; "min Aram," Bam 23:7). **Tikkun LhK**: fell ra of Targum, raise tov. **Lavan "yegar sahadusa"** vs **Yaakov "Gal Ed"** (Ber 31:47). **"Va'yapel tardeimah"** (Ber 2:21; Arizal LT Va'eschanan: tardeimah=gematria Targum); **Va'yapel**=r"t P.L.V.Y. "peh lahem v'lo yedabru" (Teh 115:5; 135:16). **Yosef pashar chalmin** (Ber 41) via mastering Targum.
intermediate.he: **תרגום=עץ הדעת=אמצעי; שם "אשה משכלת/משכיל-משכל"** (מש' יט, יד; פס' קיז. "משכיל ע"י תורגמן"). התגברות קליפה דרך תרגום=ארמי ("ארמי אובד אבי", דב' כו, ה; "מן ארם", במ' כג, ז). **תיקון לשוה"ק**: הפלת רע התרגום, העלאת טוב. **לבן "יגר שהדותא"** מול **יעקב "גלעד"** (בר' לא, מז). **"ויפל תרדמה"** (בר' ב, כא; האריז"ל לק"ת ואתחנן: תרדמה=גימ' תרגום); **ויפל**=ר"ת פ.ל.ו.י. "פה להם ולא ידברו" (תה' קטו, ה; קלה, טז). **יוסף פשר חלמין** (בר' מא) ע"י שליטה בתרגום.

scholarly.he: תרגום=עץ הדעת (מש' יט, יד; פס' קיז.); ארמי אובד אבי (דב' כו, ה; במ' כג, ז); יגר שהדותא/גלעד (בר' לא, מז); תרדמה=גימ' תרגום (האריז"ל ואתחנן); ויפל=פ.ל.ו.י. (תה' קטו, ה; קלה, טז); יוסף/חלמין (בר' מא).

intermediate.en: **"ה"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ה"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"**Mikreh laylah** (Devarim 23:11): ru'ach se'arah / ru'ach shtus / 70 lashonos rises **via Targum → via tardeimah → via sheinah**, and suckles from LhK / ru'ach ha'kodesh / bris kodesh."** **"One with shleimus LhK **cools his heat through LhK** — **'cham libi b'kirbi... dibarti bi'lshoni'** (Tehillim 39:4) — cooling the heat via dibbur of LhK; **'zos ha'pa'am etzem mei'atzamai'** (Bereshis 2:23) — 'nis'krerah da'to b'Chavah' (Yevamos 63a)."** **"But one without shleimus LhK — ru'ach se'arah cools him via **mikreh laylah bi'sheinah** — **'asher karcha ba'derech'** (Devarim 25:18) — lashon of **kar** (cooling); **'derech'** = **'ken derech ishah m'na'efes'** (Mishlei 30:20) — ru'ach se'arah takes the **Targum/nogah** path and suckles from **chashmal**."**

intermediate.en: **Mikreh laylah** (Dev 23:11): 70 lashonos rises via **Targum→tardeimah→sheinah** → suckles from LhK. **Shleimus LhK** cools heat via **dibbur** ("cham libi... dibarti bi'lshoni," Teh 39:4; Yev 63a "nis'krerah da'to b'Chavah"). Without LhK: cooling via **mikreh laylah** — **"asher karcha ba'derech"** (Dev 25:18; "derech ishah m'na'efes," Mishlei 30:20) via Targum/nogah.
intermediate.he: **מקרה לילה** (דב' כג, יא): ע' לשונות עולה דרך **תרגום→תרדמה→שינה** → יונק מלשוה"ק. **שלמות לשוה"ק** מקררת חום ע"י **דיבור** ("חם לבי... דברתי בלשוני", תה' לט, ד; יב' סג. "נתקררה דעתו בחוה"). בלי לשוה"ק: קירור ע"י **מקרה לילה** — **"אשר קרך בדרך"** (דב' כה, יח; "דרך אשה מנאפת", מש' ל, כ) דרך תרגום/נוגה.

scholarly.he: מקרה לילה (דב' כג, יא); דב' כה, יח; מש' ל, כ; יב' סג.; תה' לט, ד.

beginner.en: **"**Elisha** inherited ru'ach ha'kodesh from Eliyahu → shleimus LhK: **'vi'yhi na pi shnayim b'ruchacha elai'** (Melachim II 2:9) — **pi shnayim = LhK** — 'shnayim mikra v'echad Targum' (Berachos 8a). Hence: **'ish kadosh oveir aleinu tamid'** — **'she'lo ra'asah keri al s'dino'** (Berachos 10b). Via shleimus LhK, saved from mikreh laylah; via shleimus LhK → tikkun ha'bris (as above)."** **"David asked: **'rosh m'sibai amal s'faseimo y'chasumo'** (Tehillim 140:10). **Rosh m'sibai** = **'nogah lo saviv'** (Yechezkel 1:4) = chief of the circlers of kedushah = **Targum** — its **amal v'ra** shall be nullified; and of the other umos' lashonos (= medorah shel shivin kochvin) — **'yimotu aleihem gechalim... ki mei'eish yatz'u v'ha'eish tochaleim'** (Yechezkel 15:4-7). **Nogah/Targum** must be **purified — ra falls, tov rises into LhK** (shleimus LhK via Targum). Other 70 = totally destroyed."** **"This is also **shalhuva d'esha** descending on Erev Shabbos on klipos — so they don't enter nogah to suckle from kedushah. At kenisas Shabbos, nogah is absorbed into kedushah; other klipos try to rise, and the shalhuva descends. **Sod kavanas rechitzas mayim chamin Erev Shabbos**."**

intermediate.en: **Elisha pi shnayim** (Mel II 2:9) = LhK ("shnayim mikra v'echad Targum," Ber 8a) → "ish kadosh... lo ra'asah keri" (Ber 10b). David: **"rosh m'sibai amal s'faseimo y'chasumo"** (Teh 140:10) = **nogah lo saviv** (Yech 1:4) = Targum: ra must be nullified. Other umos: **"yimotu aleihem gechalim, ki mei'eish yatz'u"** (Yech 15:4-7) = totally consumed. **Shalhuva d'esha** on klipos Erev Shabbos (sod rechitzas chamin).
intermediate.he: **אלישע פי שניים** (מל"ב ב, ט) = לשוה"ק ("שניים מקרא ואחד תרגום", בר' ח.) → "איש קדוש... לא ראתה קרי" (בר' י:). דוד: **"ראש מסביי עמל שפתימו יכסמו"** (תה' קמ, י) = **נוגה לו סביב** (יחז' א, ד) = תרגום: הרע יתבטל. שאר אומות: **"ימוטו עליהם גחלים, כי מאש יצאו"** (יחז' טו, ד-ז) = כליה מוחלטת. **שלהובא דאשא** על קליפות בערב שבת (סוד רחיצת חמין).

scholarly.he: אלישע (מל"ב ב, ט); פי שניים (בר' ח.); איש קדוש (בר' י:). תה' קמ, י; יחז' א, ד; טו, ד-ז. שלהובא דאשא/רחיצת חמין.

intermediate.en: **"ו"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ו"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"When the tov of Targum is raised and LhK (through which the world was created) is completed — the **power of the letters of LhK** in every thing in the world is aroused and enlarged. Every davar contains combinations of letters by which it was created. Via shleimus LhK via Targum — these letter-powers are aroused."** **"**'V'atah yigdal na koach Hashem ka'asher dibarta lei'mor'** (Bamidbar 14:17) — **'lei'mor' = giluy arayos** (Sanhedrin 56b) = medorah shel shivin kochvin = ta'avas ni'uf, nullified by LhK's dibbur. **'Ka'asher dibarta lei'mor'** — according to the dibbur-of-LhK (which breaks ta'avas ni'uf), so does **'yigdal koach Hashem'** — the letters in every davar of ma'aseh bereshis (Zohar Pinchas 245a)."**

intermediate.en: Raising tov Targum + completing LhK → **letters in every davar aroused**. **"V'atah yigdal koach Hashem ka'asher dibarta lei'mor"** (Bam 14:17; San 56b "lei'mor=giluy arayos"): proportional — as LhK dibbur breaks ta'avas ni'uf, so yigdal koach Hashem = letters of ma'aseh bereshis (Zohar Pin 245a).
intermediate.he: העלאת טוב התרגום + שלמות לשוה"ק → **אותיות בכל דבר מתעוררות**. **"ועתה יגדל נא כוח ה' כאשר דברת לאמור"** (במ' יד, יז; סנ' נו: "לאמור=גילוי עריות"): פרופורציונלי — ככל ששבירת תאוות ניאוף ע"י לשוה"ק, כך יגדל כוח ה' = אותיות מעשה בראשית (זוה"ק פינ' רמה.).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. במ' יד, יז; סנ' נו:; זוה"ק פינ' רמה.

intermediate.en: **"ז"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ז"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"One who arouses the **hisnotzetzus ha'osiyos** in every ma'aseh bereshis — his eating, drinking, pleasures come **only from the sparking of letters** in the food/drink, bechina of **'va'yochal va'yeisht va'yeitav libo'** (Rus 3:7). **'Va'yeitav libo'** = **hisnotzetzus of the letters of Lamed-Bet Elokim** (the **32 Elokim** of ma'aseh bereshis in every davar). **Tov = or** — 'va'yare Elokim es ha'or ki tov' (Bereshis 1:4)."** **"**'Va'yeitav libo'** = **birchas ha'mazon** (Zohar Vayakhel 218a; Midrash Rabbah Rus 5) — eating from **hisnotzetzus ha'osiyos**, for **mazon is blessed via shleimus LhK**, arousing letters in every davar — so essential achilah/shtiyah/ta'anugim must be from there."**

intermediate.en: **Arousing osiyos-sparks in every davar** → "va'yochal va'yeisht va'yeitav libo" (Rus 3:7): libo=**Lamed-Bet Elokim** of ma'aseh bereshis; "tov=or" (Ber 1:4). Libo=**birchas ha'mazon** (Zohar Vayakhel 218a; Rus Rabbah 5); mazon blessed via shleimus LhK.
intermediate.he: **עוררות ניצוצי אותיות בכל דבר** → "ויאכל וישת וייטב ליבו" (רות ג, ז): ליבו=**ל"ב אלוקים** דמעשה בראשית; "טוב=אור" (בר' א, ד). ליבו=**ברכת המזון** (זוה"ק ויקהל ריח.; רות רבה ה); מזון מתברך דרך שלמות לשוה"ק.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. רות ג, ז; ל"ב אלוקים; בר' א, ד; זוה"ק ויקהל ריח.; רות רבה ה.

intermediate.en: **"ח"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ח"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"Any **chacham pashut** (even if not a tzaddik) can know the letters that created a given thing — if he knows the **kochos of sweetness/bitterness/sharpness/saltiness, softening/hardening, expanding/contracting**, and the **division of letters into 3 Imos + 7 double + 12 simple** (Sefer Yetzirah), and which letter belongs to each sefirah, and the quality of each sefirah — then through **taste/sight**, he understands the letter-combinations that created the davar."** **"Every davar is different in taste/smell/form — all per **tzeirufei osiyos of LhK** that HKBH weighed in His wisdom and ratzon pashut. Chasros v'yeterus (fullness/defectiveness) and nekudos in Torah are all per **mishkal** — slight additions/omissions tune the koach ha'Shem perfectly."** **"A chacham can **understand** this through chochmah alone — but to actually **feel ta'anug only from the letters** (bechina of 'va'yochal va'yeisht') is possible only for one who has **shleimus LhK** — one who brought a new hisnotzetzus into LhK's letters, which is in every davar. Such a tzaddik has ta'anug only from the **hisnotzetzus ha'osiyos**, not from the physical substance."** **"**'U'mi'Tziyon yis'adecha'** (Tehillim 20:3) — your se'udah (achilah + shtiyah + ta'anugim) should be **from the tzion ve'siman of letters** marking each davar (taste/smell/form = siman). **'Yishlach ezrecha mi'kodesh'** — **ezer** = 'e'eseh lo ezer' (Bereshis 2:18) = Chavah = LhK; **mi'kodesh** = LhK. **Sofei teivos of 'Yishlach Ezrecha Mi'kodesh' = **ח.ש.כ. (choshech)** = **tardeimah/Targum** — for ikar shleimus LhK is via Targum."**

intermediate.en: **Chacham pashut** knows letters in each davar via **3 Imos + 7 doubles + 12 simple** (Sefer Yetzirah), sefirah-letter correspondences, koach of tastes/traits. Every davar = **tzeiruf osiyos** weighed in chasros/yeterus/nekudos. But **ta'anug only from osiyos** (va'yochal... va'yeitav libo, Rus 3:7) requires **shleimus LhK**. **"U'mi'Tziyon yis'adecha"** (Teh 20:3) = se'udah from tzion/siman of letters. **"Yishlach ezrecha mi'kodesh"**: ezer=Chavah=LhK (Ber 2:18); mi'kodesh=LhK; sofei teivos ח.ש.כ.=Targum/tardeimah.
intermediate.he: **חכם פשוט** יודע אותיות בכל דבר דרך **ג' אמות + ז' כפולות + יב פשוטות** (ס"י), אות-ספירה, כוח הטעמים/המידות. כל דבר = **צרוף אותיות** שקול בחסרות/יתרות/נקודות. אבל **תענוג רק מהאותיות** (ויאכל... וייטב ליבו, רות ג, ז) דורש **שלמות לשוה"ק**. **"וממעון יסעדך"** (תה' כ, ג) = סעודה מציון/סימן של אותיות. **"ישלח עזרך מקודש"**: עזר=חוה=לשוה"ק (בר' ב, יח); מקודש=לשוה"ק; ס"ת ח.ש.כ.=תרגום/תרדמה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. ס"י: ג' אמות+ז' כפולות+י"ב פשוטות; חכם פשוט-ידיעה; תענוג מאותיות=שלמות לשוה"ק (רות ג, ז). תה' כ, ג; בר' ב, יח; ס"ת ח.ש.כ.=תרדמה/תרגום.

intermediate.en: **"ט"** heading.
intermediate.he: **"ט"** כותרת.

beginner.en: **"One at this madreigah — **'u'mi'Tziyon yis'adecha'** — **his heart shines**. The heart receives from **'shufra d'shufra'** (Zohar Pinchas 216b, 221b) from **L"B Elokim** of ma'aseh bereshis = letters in every davar. Via this sparking, **his face shines**: **'lev sameach yeitav panim'** (Mishlei 15:13). When his face shines with this **hizdakchus**, another can **see his face mirrored in that face** and repent (as above)."** **"**'Panim b'panim diber Hashem imachem'** (Devarim 5:4) — because **dibbur Hashem = shleimus LhK is with you**, face sparkles and **panim b'panim** is possible."**

intermediate.en: **U'mi'Tziyon yis'adecha → lev shines** from **shufra d'shufra** / **L"B Elokim** (Zohar Pin 216b; 221b) → **panim shine** ("lev sameach yeitav panim," Mishlei 15:13) → **panim b'panim** (Dev 5:4 "diber Hashem imachem"=shleimus LhK).
intermediate.he: **וממעון יסעדך → לב מאיר** מ**שופרא דשופרא** / **ל"ב אלוקים** (זוה"ק פינ' רטז:; רכא:) → **פנים מאירות** ("לב שמח ייטב פנים", מש' טו, יג) → **פנים בפנים** (דב' ה, ד "דיבר ה' עמכם"=שלמות לשוה"ק).

scholarly.he: סעיף ט. זוה"ק פינ' רטז:; רכא:; מש' טו, יג; דב' ה, ד.

beginner.en: **"This is: **'ad lo havi matkala, lo havi mashgichin apin b'apin'** (Zohar Terumah 176b). **Matkala** = shleimus LhK — called thus because HKBH weighed (sakal) letters: **'la'asos la'ru'ach mishkal'** (Iyov 28:25) — weighing how many letters to each davar (per taste/smell/form per His ratzon)."** **"Before LhK was complete — **'lo havi mashgichin apin b'apin'** — no panim-b'panim, because illuminated faces (mirror) require **matkala = shleimus LhK**. And ikar panim b'panim = via **'diber Hashem imachem'** (as above)."** **"**Matkala** itself = shleimus LhK via Targum = **nogah**, also called **tikla** (as known)."**

intermediate.en: **"Ad lo havi matkala"** = shleimus LhK ("la'asos la'ru'ach mishkal," Iyov 28:25 — weighed letters). Before completion → no panim b'panim (requires matkala). Matkala via Targum=nogah=tikla.
intermediate.he: **"עד לא הוה מתקלא"** = שלמות לשוה"ק ("לעשות לרוח משקל", איוב כח, כה — אותיות שקולות). לפני השלמה → אין פנים בפנים (דורש מתקלא). מתקלא דרך תרגום=נוגה=תקלא.

scholarly.he: זוה"ק תרומה קעו:; איוב כח, כה. מתקלא=שלמות לשוה"ק.

beginner.en: **"Chiluk between hearing from Rav / from talmid / from sefer: **tzaddikim = 'giborei koach osei d'varo'** (Tehillim 103:20) — they **build/make the Dibbur of HKBH** (= LhK, with which world was created), bechina of **'nimlach b'nishmoseihem shel tzaddikim u'vara es ha'olam'** (Bereshis Rabbah 8). Via sha'ashu'im He foresaw from tzaddikim's neshamos → **'bi'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu u'v'ruach piv kol tz'va'am'** (Tehillim 33:6) = making of dibbur LhK."** **"Even now: tzaddikim wishing to hear a dibbur from HKBH **first make the dibbur** (via their ma'asim tovim) — and then hear it: **'osei d'varo li'shmo'a b'kol d'varo'** (Tehillim 103:20) — first osei (make), then li'shmo'a (hear)."**

intermediate.en: **Tzaddikim="giborei koach osei d'varo li'shmo'a b'kol d'varo"** (Teh 103:20) — they **make the dibbur** (via ma'asim) then hear it. HKBH created world by taking counsel with tzaddikim's neshamos (BR 8; Teh 33:6 "bi'dvar Hashem shamayim").
intermediate.he: **צדיקים="גיבורי כוח עושי דברו לשמוע בקול דברו"** (תה' קג, כ) — **עושים את הדיבור** (ע"י מעשים) ואח"כ שומעים. הקב"ה ברא עולם ע"י התייעצות עם נשמות צדיקים (ב"ר ח; תה' לג, ו "בדבר ה' שמים").

scholarly.he: תה' קג, כ; לג, ו; ב"ר ח — עושי דברו.

beginner.en: **"Shleimus ha'dibbur of LhK tolueh b'yirah, bechina of 'asa'ah k'otzar' (above); 'yirah tolueh ba'udnin' (Tikkun 70). When the tzaddik hears Torah from HKBH, the dibbur has shleimus (bris-yirah-udnin chain). Hearing directly = receiving LhK in shleimus. Hearing from another = descended from shleimus."**

intermediate.en: **Shleimus dibbur LhK tolueh b'yirah** (otzar); **yirah tolueh ba'udnin** (Tik 70). Direct hearing=shleimus; transmitted=descent.
intermediate.he: **שלמות דיבור לשוה"ק תלויה ביראה** (אוצר); **יראה תלויה באודנין** (תיקון ע). שמיעה ישירה=שלמות; דרך אחרים=ירידה.

beginner.en: **"**'Hashem, shama'ti shim'acha, ya'reisi'** (Chavakuk 3:2) — when the shemi'ah is from **Hashem Himself** (bechina of 'osei d'varo li'shmo'a b'kol d'varo'). **'Shim'acha'** = hearing from You Yourself = ya'reisi — because ikar yirah bi'udnin, and then LhK has shleimus."** **"**'Hashem pa'al'cha b'kerev shanim, chayehu'** (ibid.). **Chayehu** — Rashi: 'o'r'reihu' ('arouse it') → pa'al'cha = koach ma'aseh bereshis aroused. **'B'kerev shanim'** — al tikrei shanim ela **shnayim** (Sotah 49) = **shnayim mikra** = LhK. Via shleimus LhK (via yirah-udnin) — koach ma'aseh bereshis is aroused."** **"Rashi on 'Tefilah l'Chavakuk al shigyonos' = **k'sargumo** — because essential shleimus LhK is via Targum. **Al shigyonos** = **shoggeg** = bechina of Targum = Etz ha'Da'as tov+ra — **shogeg** has both (action ra, intent tov)."**

intermediate.en: **"Hashem shama'ti shim'acha, ya'reisi"** (Chav 3:2): hearing from HKBH Himself → yirah (udnin). **"Pa'al'cha b'kerev shanim, chayehu"** (Rashi: o'r'reihu): shanim→**shnayim** (Sot 49)=LhK → arouse ma'aseh bereshis. **Al shigyonos=k'sargumo**=shogeg (tov+ra=Targum/Etz ha'Da'as).
intermediate.he: **"ה' שמעתי שמעך יראתי"** (חב' ג, ב): שמיעה מהקב"ה עצמו → יראה (אודנין). **"פעלך בקרב שנים חייהו"** (רש"י: עוררהו): שנים→**שניים** (סוטה מט)=לשוה"ק → עוררות מעשה בראשית. **על שגיונות=כתרגומו**=שוגג (טוב+רע=תרגום/עץ הדעת).

scholarly.he: חב' ג, ב; סוטה מט; שנים=שנים מקרא; שגיונות=שוגג=תרגום.

beginner.en: **"(Hashmatos shayach l'Torah ha'zos)"** — 'Supplements belonging to this Torah.'

intermediate.en: **"Hashmatos"** — supplements.
intermediate.he: **"השמטות"** — השלמות.

beginner.en: **"Chiluk between learning in a sefer and hearing from chacham is even greater: **sefer is only zikaron**, as **'k'sov zos zikaron ba'sefer'** (Shemos 17:14). Zikaron is via **koach ha'medameh** — even a behemah has zikaron, as we see: a beast remembers where a dog bit it and flees. Therefore Chazal: **'devarim she'be'al peh, i atah rasha'i l'omram bi'chsav'** (Gittin 60b). There are deep matters here: the verse 'k'sov zos zikaron ba'sefer' applies specifically to **Torah she'bi'chsav** which **must** be written. [All this I heard from his holy mouth while writing this Torah before him, but he did not explain this matter fully.]"**

intermediate.en: Book=**only zikaron** (Shem 17:14) via **koach ha'medameh** (even behemah has); Chazal "devarim she'be'al peh — bi'chsav" (Git 60b). "K'sov zos zikaron" applies to **TShBK**. R"N: "heard from him, didn't explain fully."
intermediate.he: ספר=**רק זיכרון** (שמ' יז, יד) ע"י **כוח המדמה** (גם בהמה); "דברים שבעל פה — בכתב" (גיט' ס:). "כתוב זאת זיכרון" = **תושב"כ**. הערת ר"נ: "שמעתי ממנו, לא ביאר לעומק".

scholarly.he: שמ' יז, יד; גיט' ס:; תושב"כ בכתב.

beginner.en: **"Sod Chazal (Sanhedrin 38b): **'Adam ha'Rishon mashuch b'orlaso hayah'; 'Adam ha'Rishon bi'lshon Arami siper'** — Adam was drawn in his foreskin; spoke in Aramaic (Targum). **Via lashon Arami/Targum, the orlah (= ra kolel, bechinas lashonos ha'umos) suckled from LhK / bris kodesh** (as above). **Ikar pgam ha'bris** — drawn via lashon Targum when not raised to LhK. The two are linked: **mashuch b'orlaso + siper bi'lshon Arami** — one depends on the other."**

intermediate.en: **Sod (San 38b)**: Adam mashuch b'orlaso + bi'lshon Arami siper — **pgam ha'bris via Arami/Targum** suckling from LhK (without tikkun).
intermediate.he: **סוד (סנ' לח:)**: אדם משוך בערלתו + בלשון ארמי סיפר — **פגם הברית דרך ארמי/תרגום** יניקה מלשוה"ק (בלי תיקון).

beginner.en: **"**'Osei d'varo li'shmo'a b'kol d'varo'** — tzaddik makes the dibbur. When LhK comes from above, it is **chaser tikkun** — still needs the tov of Targum raised. Sod of **mitzvas milah**: Midrash Bereshis Rabbah 11 — the **minin's question**: how can HKBH create something **chaser tikkun**? The answer (like the tarmusin needing cooking): every davar needs tikkun; so too Adam. I.e., HKBH created all for the Ba'al Bechirah (human) who rectifies everything via **bi'rur ha'tov of Etz ha'Da'as** — therefore **tikkun ha'milah / tikkun ha'bris** is specifically below, and that = shleimus LhK via Targum. **Chashmal = chash-mal**: bechina of **milah**; **Mal = gematria 70** (shivin kochvin) — shattered/articulated away via milah = tikkun ha'bris."**

intermediate.en: **Osei d'varo**: tzaddik makes dibbur. LhK from above=**chaser tikkun**; needs Targum tov raised below. Sod milah: minin's Q (BR 11) "how create chaser tikkun?"—answer: everything needs tikkun (tarmusin), so Adam. Tikkun in this world by ba'al bechirah. **Chashmal=chash-mal**=milah. **Mal=70**=shivin kochvin shattered via milah/tikkun habris.
intermediate.he: **עושי דברו**: צדיק עושה דיבור. לשוה"ק מלמעלה=**חסר תיקון**; צריך להעלות טוב התרגום מלמטה. סוד מילה: שאלת המינים (ב"ר יא) "איך יברא חסר תיקון?"—תשובה: הכל צריך תיקון (תורמוסים), אף אדם. התיקון בעולם הזה ע"י בעל בחירה. **חשמ"ל=חש-מל**=מילה. **מ"ל=70**=שבעים כוכבין נשברים ע"י מילה/תיקון הברית.

scholarly.he: ב"ר יא — שאלת המינים; חשמל=חש-מל/מילה; מל=70=שבעים כוכבים.

beginner.en: **"Raising the **tov of Targum** is via **tikkun ha'shegagos** — rectifying all shogeg sins. Tehillim 7:1: **'shigayon l'David'** — Targum: **'tirgumah d'odiyasa l'David'**"** — i.e., Targum = odiyasa (confession over shogeg).

intermediate.en: **Raising tov Targum = tikkun shegagos** (Teh 7:1 "shigayon l'David," Tg "tirgumah d'odiyasa").
intermediate.he: **העלאת טוב תרגום = תיקון שגגות** (תה' ז, א "שגיון לדוד", ת"א "תרגומא דאודיתא").

beginner.en: **"One with shleimus LhK **knows to interpret dreams in tardeimah** — like Yosef. Dreams follow the **foods eaten**: every food has letters; during sleep, vapors rise to the mo'ach, letters combine → dream. Had one eaten the second spoonful first, a different dream would have emerged (different combinations). One with shleimus LhK knows the letters in each food → can interpret dreams. This ties back to why Yosef = pasher chalmin: via shleimus LhK via Targum (tardeimah), arousing letter-sparks in all foods."**

intermediate.en: **Shleimus LhK → pasher chalmin** (Yosef). Dreams follow foods' letter-combinations (vapors→mo'ach→letters combine). Different order of eating=different dream. LhK-master knows letters → interprets.
intermediate.he: **שלמות לשוה"ק → פותר חלומות** (יוסף). חלומות תלויים באותיות המאכלים (אדים→מוח→צרוף). סדר אכילה שונה=חלום שונה. בעל לשוה"ק יודע אותיות → פותר.

beginner.en: **"(This we found of this ma'amar from Rabbeinu's own handwriting:)"**

intermediate.en: **R"N**: found in Rabbeinu's own ms.
intermediate.he: **הערת ר"נ**: נמצא מכת"י הרבי.

beginner.en: **"'Yishlach ezrecha mi'kodesh'** etc. — re-summary of the greatness of LhK: **'la'zos yikarei ishah... lashon nofel al lashon; mi'kan she'nivra ha'olam bi'lashon ha'kodesh'**. **Ishah = LhK** with which world was created. **Chavah = lashon of dibbur** — 'lailah l'lailah yechaveh da'as.' **'La'zos yikarei ishah'** — dibbur is called **'zos'** ('v'zos asher diber lahem avihem,' Bereshis 49:28). Via LhK we are elevated above all tongues. **'Lashon nofel al lashon'** — all tongues fall before LhK, and none... **(ad kan matzanu)** — until here is what we found. End.

intermediate.en: Re-statement of the opening of the Torah, found in Rabbeinu's own ms — LhK=ishah=Chavah=world's language; 'lashon nofel al lashon'; ends abruptly at **'v'ein...'** (cut off). [Perek Tinyana of Sifra d'Tzni'usa = expounded in Torah 2 — *Emor el ha'Kohanim*.]
intermediate.he: חזרה על פתיחת התורה, מכתי"ק רבנו — לשוה"ק=אשה=חוה=לשון העולם; 'לשון נופל על לשון'; נקטע ב**'ואין...'**. [פרקא תנינא דספ"ד = תורה ב *אמור אל הכהנים*.]

scholarly.he: מכתי"ק רבנו — נקטע; פרקא תנינא = תורה ב.
